Method of Attack: Malware installed on routers or switches that controls device LEDs to transmit data in binary format to a nearby attacker via LED blinking signals
Intercepts specific data passing through the router, breaks it into binary, and signals data using router LEDs
Data exfiltration via optical sensors or video recording devices capturing LED signals
Discoverer: Cyber Security Research Center at the Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Israel
Attack Vector: Installation of malware on router or switch via security weakness such as remote code execution flaw or tainted firmware update
